independentInput.finding: A successful submission or withdrawal after Activity reconnect yielded zero report rereads. rootReproduction.finalAdditionalCase: A successful submission followed by a temporary read failure retains Retry and refuses another submission until the successful canonical reread.

correction.feedback: Only the still-current activation emits toast or refusal feedback.
correction.reconciliation: Server-confirmed submission or withdrawal retires its confirmation and revalidates the report reads that share the initiating report and read scope. History invalidation uses the initiating employee and organization. New data still comes from the existing authorized readers.
correction.retry: An accepted command remains disabled after a failed reread. The existing Retry reloads the report. Command refusal preserves its normal retry path.
